newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia clinches Pakistan wheat sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia clinches Pakistan wheat sale.

text.p: Australia has sold 112,000 tonnes of Australian Standard White (ASW) wheat to Pakistan, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Tuesday.
The sale formed part of Pakistan's tender for 315,000 tonnes of wheat for February delivery.
Trade reports on Monday said Pakistan had bought 180,000 tonnes of Australian white wheat and 135,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat.
AWB spokesman Alec Nichol would not disclose Australia's price in the deal, but said U.S. sales in the tender had been reported at about US$150.000 a tonne.
He noted that trade reports of Australian prices in the tender sale at between US$155.30 and $156.285 were above the reported U.S. prices. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
